$comment: REL-FIELD-ALGEBRA-02 Phase B: the stage-1 coordinates (census-stage1.json) that carry no necessity witness and therefore leave the kernel as not-yet-admitted, each with the earliest later stage allowed to re-earn it with its own witness. leafMap/memberMap/factorized record how the kernel carries the stage-1 coordinates that DID survive under another id or member; necessity.test.ts derives every stage-1 coordinate's disposition from this file plus witnesses.json and requires the kernel census to equal exactly the ratified set. keyRewrites are the assertion-key rewrites these removals imply for the frozen Phase-A ledger (baseline --check --ledger-only --rewrites).
